name: Wit of the Flash Fog
body:
School Abjuration; Level: jester 6

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Until the end of combat, when an effect would reduce your speed or paralyze you, you may immediately remake the saving throw as an immediate action to negate that effect, once per round.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the new saving throw.
